injuries_block.title: Injuries & pain
injuries_block.hint: Mark zones with pain or injury. If none, toggle “No injuries”.
injuries_block.empty_hint: Tap a body area to register pain or injury.
injuries_block.notes_placeholder: E.g. pain when raising the arm, started 2 weeks ago, worse during bench press.

parq_block.title: PAR-Q+ pre-screening
parq_block.hint: Standard pre-participation screening. Any 'Yes' suggests physician clearance.

questions.q1: Has a doctor ever said you have a heart condition or that you should only do physical activity recommended by a doctor?
questions.q2: Do you feel pain in your chest when you do physical activity?
questions.q3: In the past month, have you had chest pain when you were not doing physical activity?
questions.q4: Do you lose your balance because of dizziness or do you ever lose consciousness?
questions.q5: Do you have a bone or joint problem that could be made worse by a change in your physical activity?
questions.q6: Is your doctor currently prescribing drugs for blood pressure or a heart condition?
questions.q7: Do you know of any other reason why you should not do physical activity?

rationale.cardio: Cardiovascular flag. Medical clearance recommended before moderate-vigorous intensity. Protocol can still draft a low-intensity plan, flagged for physician review.
rationale.balance: Balance flag. Plan will avoid free-weight overhead movements and unsupported standing exercises until cleared by a physician.
rationale.msk: Musculoskeletal flag. Plan will exclude high-impact patterns and aggressive progressive loading. Mobility-first protocol available.
rationale.manual: Manual flag. Note specifics in client medical conditions. PDF export will include a physician-review disclaimer.

parq_block.flag_summary_note: Plan generation will default to low-intensity. Override available.

risk_block.title: Risk stratification
risk_block.hint: ACSM-style coronary risk factor count → low / moderate / high.
risk_block.family_cvd: Family history of CVD (1st-degree, <55 M / <65 F)
risk_block.family_cvd_desc: Parent or sibling with heart attack or stroke before age 55 (M) / 65 (F).
risk_block.smoking_hint: Current smokers carry highest CVD risk.
risk_block.bmi_hint: Underweight <18.5 · Normal 18.5–24.9 · Overweight 25–29.9 · Obese ≥30. Use 'Muscular' when BMI ≥25 but body-fat % is within athletic range (♂ ≤17%, ♀ ≤24%) — BMI overestimates adiposity in resistance-trained individuals.
risk_block.bmi_missing_hw: Add the client's height and weight to compute BMI.
risk_block.bmi_underweight_meaning: BMI <18.5 — underweight. Review nutrition and energy availability before raising training volume.
risk_block.bmi_normal_meaning: BMI 18.5–24.9 — normal range. No weight-based adjustment to prescribed intensity.
risk_block.bmi_overweight_meaning: BMI 25–29.9 — overweight. Counts as an ACSM risk factor when paired with other markers.
risk_block.bmi_obese_meaning: BMI ≥30 — obesity. ACSM risk factor. Watch axial loading and joint impact.
risk_block.bmi_muscular_meaning: High BMI but body-fat % in athletic range (≤17% M / ≤24% F). Does not count as a risk factor.
risk_block.dyslipidemia_desc: Abnormal cholesterol or triglycerides — confirmed by labs or on medication.
risk_block.hypertension_desc: BP ≥130/80 mmHg on two readings or on antihypertensive therapy.
risk_block.complete_meaning_low: No relevant cardiovascular factors — vigorous intensities are on the table within the ACSM ruler.
risk_block.complete_meaning_moderate: Two or more factors or mild symptoms — cap high intensity without clinical screening and monitor cardiovascular signs.
risk_block.complete_meaning_high: Known disease or symptoms — require medical clearance before vigorous progressions.

anthro_block.title: Anthropometry
anthro_block.hint: Body composition baseline. Waist-to-hip ratio is computed automatically.
anthro_block.waist_hint: Measure at narrowest point above the hip bone, exhale.
anthro_block.hip_hint: Measure at the widest part of the buttocks.
anthro_block.bf_pct_hint: Optional. Use the same method over time for trend.
anthro_block.measure_height_instructions: Standing, barefoot, heels together, looking forward. Inhale.
anthro_block.measure_waist_instructions: At the narrowest point above the hip, standing, exhaled.
anthro_block.measure_hip_instructions: At the widest point of the hip, feet together.
anthro_block.measure_chest_instructions: At nipple level, standing, arms relaxed.
anthro_block.measure_arm_instructions: Mid-biceps, arm relaxed at the side.
anthro_block.measure_thigh_instructions: Midpoint between hip and knee, standing, weight balanced.
anthro_block.measure_calf_instructions: Widest point of the calf, standing, weight balanced.

meds_block.title: Medication & supplements
meds_block.hint: Beta-blockers blunt HR; statins risk myalgia; anticoagulants require contact-sport caution.
meds_block.effect_beta: Blunts HR — use RPE instead of HR zones
meds_block.effect_anticoag: Avoid contact and falls — caution in plyo
meds_block.effect_bronchodilator: Long warm-up, keep SABA on hand
meds_block.effect_thyroid: Usually neutral — watch HR if dose changed

no_meds_toggle.label: I do not take any medications or supplements
no_meds_toggle.help: Tick this if the client uses nothing on a regular basis — including multivitamins. Selecting this disables the list below.

completion.missing_intro: These items block plan generation. Tap "Go to section" to fix each one.

reasons.parq: Answer all 7 PAR-Q+ questions (Yes or No).
reasons.risk: Confirm BMI category and risk stratification.
reasons.training: Set experience, days per week, session duration and available equipment.
reasons.injuries: Either tick "No injuries" or add at least one injury on the body map.
reasons.history: Add training years, previous program style or known max lifts.
reasons.goal: Write the work focus and how progress will be measured.
reasons.meds: Declare medications/supplements or tick "I take none".
reasons.lifestyle: Add sleep, stress or sedentary routine info.
reasons.nutrition: Add meals per day, water or weekly alcohol intake.
reasons.posture: Note posture, asymmetries or dominant side.
reasons.screen: Tick at least 3 form criteria per pattern (or mark "Not assessed").
reasons.performance: Add resting HR or a cardio test result.

goal_block.title: Primary goal (SMART)
goal_block.hint: Measurable commitment to work over a time window.
goal_block.specific_placeholder: e.g. squat strength, technique and progress
goal_block.measurable_placeholder: e.g. 1RM/5RM on the squat; measure every 4 weeks
goal_block.measurable_hint: Metric + frequency. Exploratory target, adjusted by real data.
goal_block.deadline_hint: When we reassess progress. Not a finish line.

goals.empty: Pick a category to see common work focuses
goals.confirm_overwrite: You've customised the fields. Replace with the template?

cv_rhr_lower.specific: Lower resting heart rate over 12 weeks
cv_rhr_lower.measurable: Track morning RHR every 2 weeks; exploratory target: −5 to −10 bpm

cv_bp_systolic.specific: Lower systolic blood pressure over 16 weeks
cv_bp_systolic.measurable: Measure BP weekly; exploratory target: −5 to −10 mmHg

cv_cooper_2400.measurable: Re-run Cooper 12 min every 4 weeks; exploratory target: ≥ 2400 m

str_squat_1bw_5.measurable: Track 1RM/5RM on the back-squat; exploratory target: 1×BW × 5 reps

str_squat_15bw_5.measurable: Track 1RM/5RM on the back-squat; exploratory target: 1.5×BW × 5 reps

str_bench_75bw_5.specific: Build horizontal pressing strength over 16 weeks
str_bench_75bw_5.measurable: Track 1RM/5RM on bench; exploratory target: 0.75×BW × 5 reps

str_dl_15bw_5.specific: Build pulling and posterior chain strength over 16 weeks
str_dl_15bw_5.measurable: Track 1RM/5RM on the deadlift; exploratory target: 1.5×BW × 5 reps

hyp_arm.measurable: Measure arm circumference every 4 weeks; observe trend

hyp_thigh.measurable: Measure thigh circumference every 4 weeks; observe trend

hyp_glutes.measurable: Measure hip circumference every 4 weeks; observe trend

comp_fatloss.specific: Reduce fat mass over 16 weeks, preserving lean mass
comp_fatloss.measurable: Track composition (DEXA/BIA) every 4-6 weeks; adjust by trajectory

comp_recomp.specific: Body recomposition over 20 weeks (lose fat, gain lean mass)
comp_recomp.measurable: Track composition and strength in parallel; adjust by response

comp_waist.measurable: Measure waist every 2 weeks; observe trend

end_5k_continuous.measurable: Progressively extend continuous run time; reassess every 2 weeks

end_5k_25min.specific: Build 5 km running endurance over 10 weeks
end_5k_25min.measurable: Track 5 km time every 3-4 weeks; exploratory target: ≤ 25:00

end_cooper.measurable: Re-run Cooper 12 min every 4 weeks; observe progress

mob_toes.specific: Work lumbar and hamstring mobility over 6 weeks

mob_overhead.specific: Work thoracic and shoulder mobility over 8 weeks

mob_squat_deep.specific: Achieve pain-free deep squat over 8 weeks
mob_squat_deep.measurable: Assess depth and quality every 2 weeks

mob_cervical.measurable: Measure bilateral cervical rotation every 2 weeks

fn_floor_rise.specific: Rise from floor unaided over 6 weeks

fn_stairs_unaided.specific: Climb stairs without handrail over 4 weeks

fn_carry.specific: Work functional carry strength over 8 weeks
fn_carry.measurable: Time on farmer's carry with progressive load; reassess every 2 weeks

skill_handstand.measurable: Track wall→free handstand progression; measure hold time

skill_split.specific: Work toward split flexibility over 24 weeks

skill_first_pullup.specific: Achieve first full pullup over 12 weeks
skill_first_pullup.measurable: Track deadhang reps and assistance progression

builder.label: Which specific skill?
builder.hint: Curated, deterministic lookup. No AI — only skills we already know how to prescribe.
builder.placeholder: e.g. I want to do a handstand
builder.unmatched_body: “{{text}}” isn't in our curated lookup yet. Rather than invent a prescription, we logged the suggestion for review.
builder.logged: Logged for curation. In the meantime, write the goal manually below.

handstand.measurable: wall→free progression; measure hold time every 4 weeks
handstand.note: Prerequisites: shoulder strength and mobility. Assess overhead reach and shoulder press strength before starting.

split.specific: Work toward front split over 24 weeks
split.note: Prerequisites: passive stretch tolerance. Sit-and-reach + hip abduction ROM as baseline.

pullup.specific: Achieve first full pullup over 12 weeks
pullup.measurable: Track deadhang reps and assisted-pullup progression
pullup.note: Prerequisites: deadhang time and base pulling strength. Measure pullup_max (assisted) and deadhang_max.

muscle_up.measurable: Track high explosive pullups + dips; monthly transition test
muscle_up.note: Non-negotiable prerequisites: ≥10 strict pullups + ≥10 dips. Assess before starting.

planche.measurable: tuck→straddle→full progression; measure hold every 4 weeks
planche.note: Prerequisites: extreme scapular protraction strength. Pseudo planche pushup + protraction ROM as baseline.

front_lever.specific: Work toward front lever over 32 weeks
front_lever.measurable: tuck→advanced tuck→straddle progression; measure hold monthly
front_lever.note: Prerequisites: ≥8 pullups + anti-extension core strength. Tuck front lever hold as baseline.

back_lever.specific: Work toward back lever over 24 weeks
back_lever.note: Prerequisites: shoulder extension mobility + pulling strength. Tuck back lever hold as baseline.

bridge.specific: Work toward full bridge over 12 weeks
bridge.measurable: Assess bridge quality and shoulder extension ROM every 2 weeks
bridge.note: Prerequisites: thoracic and shoulder mobility. Without partial bridge — start at wall walk level.

pistol_squat.specific: Work toward pistol squat over 16 weeks
pistol_squat.measurable: Single-leg reps every 4 weeks; measure depth
pistol_squat.note: Prerequisites: unilateral strength, balance and ankle mobility. 1RM squat + single-leg balance as baseline.

human_flag.specific: Work toward human flag over 32 weeks
human_flag.note: Prerequisites: lateral core strength and unilateral pulling. Side plank max + pullup_max as baseline.

single_leg_deadlift.specific: Work toward single-leg deadlift over 12 weeks
single_leg_deadlift.note: Prerequisites: posterior chain dominance and balance. 1RM deadlift + single-leg balance as baseline.

first_pushup.specific: Achieve first full pushup over 8 weeks
first_pushup.measurable: Incline pushup reps every 2 weeks; lower incline progressively
first_pushup.note: No strict prerequisites. Start at maximum incline pushup level.

readiness_block.title: Where are you right now?
readiness_block.hint: How they relate to training right now — calibrates the tone and pace of the first weeks.
readiness_block.help_body: Prochaska's stages of behavior change. Pick what best describes the current relationship with training. There's no right answer — it decides whether we lean on education, structure, or intensity.

training_block.title: Training setup
training_block.hint: Frequency, location, available equipment, and constraints.

lifestyle_block.title: Lifestyle & recovery
lifestyle_block.hint: Daily activity, recovery markers, and sleep/stress modulators.
lifestyle_block.sleep_hint: Subjective average sleep quality this past month.
lifestyle_block.hours_seated_hint: Total sitting time including work + commute.

mobility_block.title: Mobility — anatomical (1–5)
mobility_block.hint: Score each region: 1 = severely restricted, 5 = full pain-free range.
mobility_block.rubric: 1 = severe limitation/pain; 2 = clear limitation; 3 = acceptable but limited; 4 = good with minor limitation; 5 = full, controlled, symmetrical and pain-free.
mobility_block.shoulder_hint: Standing, raise both arms sideways to touch your ears. No pain and no trunk rotation = 5.
mobility_block.hip_hint: Lying on your back, bring one knee to your chest. Thigh meets torso without lifting the opposite hip = 5.
mobility_block.ankle_hint: Standing ~10 cm from a wall, bend your knee to touch the wall without lifting the heel = 5.
mobility_block.thoracic_hint: Seated, hands behind head, rotate trunk to each side. ~45° symmetric without lumbar cheating = 5.
mobility_block.wrist_hint: Palm up, use your other hand to pull fingers down. 90° flexion without pain = 5.
mobility_block.knee_hint: Seated, fully extend the knee. Heel lifts without pain and no pulling behind the knee = 5.

screen_block.title: Movement screen
screen_block.hint: Functional pattern quality. 1 = restricted → 5 = controlled full range.

history_block.title: Training history
history_block.hint: Prior exposure shapes starting loads and progression rates.
history_block.tier_hint: Grouped by years of regular practice. Tunes starting loads and progression.
history_block.max_lifts_help: 1-rep max loads or recent estimate. Optional — leave blank if unknown. Shorthand: SQ = squat, BP = bench, DL = deadlift, OHP = overhead press.

performance_block.title: Cardiovascular health
performance_block.rhr_help: Resting heart rate. How to measure: first thing in the morning, still in bed. Count pulses at the wrist or neck for 60s (or 30s × 2). Ideally 3 mornings in a row, take the average. Typical: <60 bpm = strong aerobic base · 60–80 bpm = normal · >80 bpm = poor recovery or stress.
performance_block.rockport_protocol: Walk 1 mile (1.6 km) as fast as possible without running. Use a stopwatch. Immediately on arrival, measure pulse for 15s × 4. Enter values below.
performance_block.rockport_missing_prereq: Missing weight, age or sex in profile — fill Anthropometry first.

discard.title: Discard assessment draft?
discard.desc: Clears all fields above. Saved assessments stay in the database until next save.

snapshot.title: Client snapshot
snapshot.risk_acsm_help: American College of Sports Medicine risk stratification: combines cardiovascular risk factors (age, smoking, hypertension, dyslipidemia, pre-diabetes, obesity, family history) and symptoms to set how hard we can push intensity.
snapshot.risk_acsm_meaning_low: No relevant factors — free prescription within the ACSM ruler, including vigorous intensities.
snapshot.risk_acsm_meaning_moderate: ≥2 factors or mild symptoms — cap high intensity without clinical screening and monitor cardiovascular signs.
snapshot.risk_acsm_meaning_high: Known disease or symptoms — require medical clearance before vigorous progressions.

summary_pdf.title: Assessment summary
summary_pdf.implications_intro: Deterministic list derived from the assessment. Each item is guidance for the trainer — not a diagnosis.

implications.parq: {{count}} positive PAR-Q answer(s) reported. Confirm clearance before progressing intensity.
implications.risk_obese: Start with a conservative tier (MEV) and a gradual progression curve.
implications.beta_blocker: Heart-rate response may be blunted — prefer RPE / talk test over HR zones.
implications.anticoagulant: Caution with falls, contact and impact. Avoid risky exercises.
implications.hypoglycemia: Watch for hypoglycemia in long sessions; plan fueling and shorter blocks.
implications.pain_notes: Active pain reported — review before loading the affected pattern.
implications.low_recovery: Reduced recovery signals — start with a conservative RPE ceiling (≤7.5) and delay progressions.
implications.readiness: Low behavioural readiness — prioritise adherence over load.
implications.beginner: Starting RPE 6.5–7.5, focus on technique and base patterns.
implications.no_equipment: No equipment — restrict selection to bodyweight movements.
implications.short_session: Short sessions — limit accessories, keep main patterns.
implications.none: No specific cautions identified. Apply standard initiation parameters.

summary_pdf.session_complete_note: All practical items (anthropometry, mobility, posture, screen, performance) are recorded.
summary_pdf.session_checklist_intro: Complete these items in the next in-person session before generating the plan.
summary_pdf.disclaimer: Document supports exercise prescription and trainer review. It is not a diagnosis or medical clearance.
